triage.evidence: We have a line of customers waiting
triage.reason: The card reader is not connected; customers are waiting.

result.reply:
Hi Omar,

The payment terminal says 'device not connected'. Please try:
1. Unplug the card reader cable and plug it back in.
2. Restart the payment app.
3. Run a test transaction.

We will contact the payment processor if the backup reader also fails.

ticket.subject: No receipts coming out
ticket.description: The receipt printer on register 4 stopped printing about an hour ago. Paper is loaded. Also, need a password reset please. I changed it last week and now it doesn't work.

triage.evidence: The receipt printer on register 4 stopped printing about an hour ago
triage.raise_check: rejected: quote doesn't fit the rule
triage.reason: Receipt printer stopped working, and the person also needs a password reset.

result.reply:
Hi Luis,

Please try the following:
1. Check that the paper roll is loaded with the shiny side facing the print head.
2. Open the cover and clear any jammed paper.
3. Turn the printer off and on.

We will confirm the printer shows as connected in POS settings.

ticket.subject: Internet down
ticket.description: the internet is down for everyone here on and off all week. nothing will load.

triage.evidence: the internet is down for everyone here
triage.reason: Nothing will load, and the whole site is affected.

result.reply:
Hi Priya,

The internet is down for everyone in your store.

Please try:
1. Check the lights on the modem and firewall.
2. Restart the modem, then the firewall, then the switch, in that order.

We will contact the internet provider if the connection is still down.

Hi Denise,

Teams is showing a blank white screen when you try to sign in.

Please try:
1. Check your microphone and speaker in Teams settings under Devices.
